title: Resident car parking per Table 2.3a (no minimum in Location A or B)
text: Car parking is provided on site in accordance with Table 2.3a. Table 2.3a Car parking¹, Resident: No minimum (one cell spanning Location A and Location B). ¹Calculations of parking ratios shall be rounded to the nearest whole number, with fractions of 0.5 or greater rounded up (for example, 1.4 bays is rounded to 1 bay and 1.5 bays is rounded to 2 bays).

replaces.note: R30-R60 Location A 0/0/1, Location B 1 per dwelling -> no minimum
R10-R25 1 to 1.5 (Location A) / 1.25 to 1.75 (Location B) per dwelling -> no minimum

notes: from: ch3 C2.3.1. diverges: Table 2.3a p20 prints 'No minimum' for resident car parking in Location A and B, with no bedroom split, so the lookup returns 0 and the rule can only fail on a negative count; kept so the provision is reported. Fact parking.resident_spaces (apartments) replaces parking.spaces. Region all: the Chapter 4 Part 1 heading and table carry no Perth and Peel limit (Chapter 3's do); the regional gap is C2.3.1-r1. Register C4P1-039 (material): ToC and Information Sheet 3 say otherwise; the draft follows Information Sheet 4.
